{{Quote|The Voss thank you, outsider.|Azula-Hej|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Azula-Hej''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was among the few of his people who left their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to see the larger [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Azula-Hej eventually settled on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where around [[3640 BBY]] he was delivered a package from his home by the [[Voidhound]].
